g.text: PMO onboarding v2 - architecture (pilot, as deployed)
People decide. The AI agent reviews, routes, verifies and reports. It never approves.
each sees only their own role
deny by default: role from userAccess
identity only from the sign-in header;
role check and ETag on every update
people see the next stage at once
The API reaches it with a connection string
(SWA app settings); the worker with its
Microsoft cloud (the project's own Entra tenant)
WorkflowAgent: one step at a time
- The agent never approves and never skips a stage.
- Writes only after the named Owner, then Security, approve;
re-checked before every write; each write switch off until approved.
- Never assigns Owner, Contributor, User Access Admin or other admin roles.
- TAP and passwords masked (******) in logs, mail and prompts.
- Acts only in its own Entra tenant; for another tenant the teams do it.
- Cost: free tiers + one Flex worker; budget INR 2,000 a month.
Azure DevOps work item, Graph sendMail
